name: Planet Labs
outlook:
What Planet Labs says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: revenue and marginFor the third quarter of fiscal year 2027, ending October 31, 2026, Planet expects revenue to be in the range of approximately $101 million to $105 million. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be in the range of approximately 56% to 58%.
  • Full fiscal year 2027: revenue and marginFor the full fiscal year 2027, Planet expects revenue to be in the range of approximately $430 million to $441 million. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be in the range of approximately 55% to 57%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
